en: We made our way to Theodore's shop...
Oh...? What brings everyone here?
Please forgive the sudden intrusion.{SAUT}We just want to ask you a few questions.
......{PAGE}What's with the huge crowd?
...Have we come at a bad time?
...Have we come at a bad time?
We were curious about your new{SAUT}popcorn recipe.{PAGE}Have you had a chance to make any{SAUT}more since you gave us that last batch?
No, I still haven't restocked the{SAUT}ingredients, so I haven't had the chance{SAUT}to do so...
I see. Very well, then.{PAGE}One more question: why is Marie-san in{SAUT}a bad mood?
Ahh, well... About that...
It's Teddie's fault.
What!?
Actually, Teddie was here just a{SAUT}moment ago...{PAGE}He very deliberately charged into Marie{SAUT}while she was eating some of my new{SAUT}popcorn.
It's the same as before.{OPTION}He's targeting the popcorn?
Yes, it is rather similar to the previous{SAUT}incident.
That seems likely. It's also similar to{SAUT}the previous incident.
I can't believe he did that to my{SAUT}popcorn...!
Perhaps I could see it happening to{SAUT}Chie-senpai and the others, but I never{SAUT}imagined he'd attack Marie-san as well...{PAGE}Around what time did you see Teddie?
Not too long ago... It was just a little{SAUT}while before I heard someone scream.{PAGE}Come to think of it, I did notice{SAUT}something strange.
Something strange...?
Yes. Teddie's walk was awfully{SAUT}unsteady at the time.{PAGE}Not only that, but he spoke not a word,{SAUT}even when I called out to him.
That is strange.{OPTION}Teddie? Silent?
Yes, it is very unnatural for Teddie not to{SAUT}respond when spoken to...
That does seem unusual. I get the feeling{SAUT}Teddie is...
...I believe you and I are thinking the{SAUT}same thing.{PAGE}The quickest way to find out would be to{SAUT}ask him directly.
In that case, shall we return to where we{SAUT}found his suit? He may already be back.
I agree. Let's go.
